title: Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. translated_title: 超越亚高斯检测分数：用于人类-大语言模型文本分割的鲁棒加权轮廓损失变点检测
translated_abstract: 混合人类与大语言模型的文档需要从可靠性在不同文本单元间存在差异的检测分数中定位作者身份的转变。现有的加权均值对比方法容易受到极端分数的影响，而直接用鲁棒中心替换均值则会模糊错置边界如何改变总体目标函数。我们提出鲁棒加权轮廓损失变点检测方法（RWCP），该方法结合了封顶的可靠性权重、Huber轮廓增益以及在可靠性坐标系中的最窄超阈值搜索。我们的关键分析将真实分割与偏移分割之间的总体差距表示为合并代价，从而避免了对混合片段的非线性中心求解闭式解。在明确的曲率、间距和依赖性条件下，核心RWCP能够恢复变点的数量并定位其边界；其二次损失极限可恢复平方加权CUSUM。我们还研究了RWCP-R，这是一个单独评估的解码器，它共享……
tldr: 提出鲁棒加权轮廓损失变点检测方法RWCP，通过封顶可靠性权重、Huber轮廓增益和可靠性坐标系中的最窄超阈值搜索，鲁棒地定位混合人类-大语言模型文档中的作者身份转变，并将真实分割与偏移分割间的总体差距表示为合并代价，避免了混合片段非线性中心的闭式求解。
en_tdlr: We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search to robustly localize authorship transitions in mixed human-LLM documents, while characterizing the population gap between true and displaced splits as a merge cost that avoids closed-form solutions for nonlinear centers of mixed segments.
